description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attack (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Blink 1] and [Warrior's Fate Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Dual Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next attack that could be evaded with [Physical Blink] or [Magical Blink], lower priority than [Physical Blink] and [Magical Blink]

description.name: Warrior's Fate Mode
description.text: Casts Blast of Light after Dual Blink 1 or Dual Blink 2 is removed, removed after triggering twice
